title: Normalized signal envelope
description: The single integration contract of the platform. Every adapter emits this shape regardless of source system. Adding a source is a mapping exercise into this vocabulary, never a schema negotiation.

signal_id.description: Deterministic v5 UUID over (tenant_id, source.adapter_id, source_native_id). Makes replay and federated merge idempotent.

estate.description: Which plane produced this. Drives federated read routing during estate migration.

subject_id.description: Resolved canonical principal, assigned by the control plane.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened at the source.

category.description: Coarse routing dimension. Maps one-to-one to bus topic suffix.

signal_type.description: Taxonomy key, e.g. file_action.copy_to_removable. Governed by taxonomy.yaml; additive only within a schema_version.

attributes.description: Type-specific fields, validated against the taxonomy entry for signal_type.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 code or subdivision that supplied the governing rule.

model_version.description: Pinned per tenant. A score without this is not comparable across time and is not admissible as evidence.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous signal on this (tenant, subject) chain. Gives an append-only ordering that a reader can verify without trusting the store.
